content: Yesuusi Ba Tamaareta Toho Meecis
Paasika bonchiya gallasay gakanaape sinthatidi ha alamiya aggidi Aawako biya wodey gakidaysa Yesuusi eris. Ha alamiyan de7iya ba asaa ubba wode dosis; wursethi gakanawuka enta dosis.
Yesuusaranne iya tamaaretara issife kaho moosona. Hessafe kase Xalahey Simoona na7aa Asqoroota Yihudi Yesuusa aathidi immanaada iya wozanan iita qofa wothis.
Yesuusi Aaway ubbaba iya kushen wothidaysa, I Xoossaa matape yidaysanne simmidi iyako baanaysa eris.
Yesuusi gayta bollafe dendidi bolla bagga ma7uwa qaari wothidi, pooxa ekidi ba xeessan marxafis.
Hessafe guye, haathe meecha miishen tigidi, ba tamaareta tohuwa meeccis; qassi ba xeessan dancida pooxan quchis.
Yesuusi Simoona Phexroosako yaa wode Phexroosi, “Godaw, ne ta tohuwa meeccanee?” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi iyako, “Taani ootheysa ne ha77i eraka, shin guyepe akeekana” yaagis.
Yaatin, Phexroosi, “Ne ta tohuwa ubbaraka meeccaka” yaagis. Yesuusi iyako, “Taani ne tohuwa meecconna ixiko newunne tawunne issifetethi baawa” yaagis.
Phexroosi Yesuusako, “Godaw, yaatiko, ta tohuwa xalaala gidonashin ta kushiyanne ta huuphiya meecca” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Bolla meecetida oonika tohope haraba meecetanaw koshshenna; iyaw ubbasoy geeshshi. Hinte geeshshi, shin ubbay geeshshi gideketa” yaagis.
Yesuusi bana aathidi immana uray ooneko eriya gisho, “Hinte ubbay geeshshi gideketa” yaagis.
Enta tohuwa meeccidaape guye, Yesuusi ba ma7uwa zaari ma7is. Simmi gayta bolla uttidi entako, “Taani hintew oothidaysa akeeketii?
Hinte tana astamaarenne Godaa geeta; taani hinte geysa gidiya gisho lo77o gideta.
Taani hintew Godanne astamaare gidashe hinte tohuwa meecciko hinteka issoy issuwas hessada oothanaw bessees.
Hiza, taani hintew oothidaysada hinteka oothana mela hintew leemiso gidas.
Taani hintew tuma odayis; aylley ba godaape, kiitetidaysi kiittidaysafe aadhenna.
Hinte hessa eridi oothiyaba gidiko anjetidaysata.
“Taani hintena ubbaa giike; taani dooridaysata erayis. Shin Geeshsha Maxaafan, ‘Ta barsidaysi ta kushiya saxis’ geetetidaysi tuma gidanaw bessees.
‘Taani Tana Gideysa’ hinte ammanana mela hessi hananaape sinthatada hintew odayis.
Taani hintew tuma odayis; taani kiitida oonaka mokiya uray tana mokees. Tana mokiya oonika tana kiittidaysa mokees” yaagis.
Yesuusa Aathidi Immana Ura
Yesuusi hessa odidaape guye, ba wozanan daro un7etidi, “Taani hintew tuma odayis; tana hintefe issoy aathidi immana” gidi qoncisidi odis.
I oodeba odiyako iya tamaaretas eretonna ixin issoy issuwa xeellidosona.
Iya tamaaretape issoy, Yesuusi doseysi, Yesuusa matan uttis.
Hessa gisho, Simoon Phexroosi iya qam7otidi, “I oona giyako ane oycha” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, he tamaarey Yesuusako shiiqidi haythan, “Godaw, I oonee?” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Taani uythaa woxen tushada barseysa” yaagis. Qassi uythaa menthi ekidi, woxen tushidi, Simoona na7aa Asqoroota Yihuda barsis.
Yihudi uythaa baaridaape guye, Xalahey ellesidi Yihudan gelis. Yesuusi iyako, “Neeni oothanaw qopidaba ellesada ootha” yaagis.
Shin gayta bolla uttidaysatape oonika Yesuusi hessa ayis iyako gidaako eribeenna.
Yihudi miishe oykiya gisho, iya tamaaretape issoti issoti Yesuusi iya, “Paasika bonchiya gallasaas bantaw koshshiyaba shamma woyko manqotas muxaata imma gis” yaagidi qopidosona.
Yihudi uythaa baarida mela ellesidi kare keyis. He wode sa7i qamma.
Phexroosi Yesuusa Kaddanaysi Odetis
Yihudi kare keydaape guye, Yesuusi, “Ha77i Asa Na7ay bonchetis; Xoossayka iya baggara bonchetis.
Xoossay iya baggara bonchetiko I ba huuphen Asa Na7aa bonchana; qassi I hessa ellesidi oothana.
Ta nayto, taani hintera daro wode gam7ike. Hinte tana koyana, shin taani Ayhudetas odidaysa mela, ‘Hinte taani biya bessaa baanaw danda7eketa.’
Taani hintew immiya ooratha kiitay haysa; issoy issuwa dosite. Taani hintena dosidaysada hinte issoy issuwa dosanaw bessees.
Hinte issoy issuwara dosetiko hinte ta tamaare gideysa asa ubbay erana” yaagis.
Simoon Phexroosi Yesuusako, “Godaw, neeni aw bay?” yaagis. Yesuusi zaaridi, “Taani biya bessaa neeni ha77i kaallanaw danda7aka, shin guyepe tana kaallana” yaagis.
Phexroosi, “Godaw, taani nena ha77i kaallanaw ayis danda7ikina? Taani ne gisho, hayqanawuka giiga uttas” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Ta gisho hayqanaw tuma giiga uttadii? Taani new tuma odayis; kuttoy waassanaape sinthe neeni tana heedzu toho kaddana” yaagis.
